title: Pilobol.us P3-07: staging site (Cognito-gated drafts preview) and staging release-gate checks
description:
## Goal
Staging site as the standard defines (docs/standard-site.md 1.10): drafts rendered as if published, behind the site's own Cognito (editor/admin), on the new CMS app's staging branch. Discharges the staging release-gate items.

## Context (FACT unless marked)
- Staging branch builds frontend-only against the production backend (ampx generate outputs), exports drafts with the editor/JWT lane, builds via reader.buildCommand, uploads to the private preview/ prefix (papyrus content upload-preview), and a Cognito-gated Next route serves it. Env on staging only: SITE_ENV=staging, PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW=static, NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_STAGING_URL.
- Gates (epic c91ed6, 19753b): PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW only on staging; 6 MB WEB_COMPUTE limit vs the largest build file, assets/he-said-he-could-see-it/gowy-fall-of-icarus.jpg at 6,047,745 bytes; static staging against a real backend; nodejs middleware.
- Code-reading finding: root-level newsroom would loop the gate; fixed by the /newsroom brand in the scaffold.
- The new stack starts without domains: staging runs on https://staging.<newCmsAppId>.amplifyapp.com until the domain ticket adds staging.pilobol.us.
- Drafts: the 3 imported drafts.

## Exact steps
1. Template flag on: staging branch in site.json; Ryan yes to the stack update (adds branch staging with its env and spec); push git branch staging (from main); connect the branch in the console if needed.
2. Probes (adapt scripts/staging-auth-test.mjs): anonymous GET / redirects to /newsroom then 200 (no loop); editor sees a draft page with the STAGING banner and the same URL is 404 on the reader; non-editor 403; robots Disallow, noindex; unsigned S3 preview URL 403; get-bucket-policy-status IsPublic false; main branch has no PAPYRUS_STAGING_PREVIEW (names).
3. Measure the 6,047,745-byte image through the gate as editor; if it fails, exclude files over 5 MB from the staging upload (staging only) and record.

## Acceptance checks
All probes pass; results recorded.

## Rollback
Delete the staging branch (stack update reversal).

## Risks
Build time 10-15 minutes; admin-level service role (documented in the shell README).

## Needs Ryan
Yes for step 1; sign in as an editor and a non-editor for the probes.

## Common rules (Phase 3 Pilobol.us, simplified plan v2)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#128). Ryan 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us is PRE-PRODUCTION, Git history is the rollback, HARD CUTOVER: no soak, no Git freeze, no dual Git/CMS build path, no parity gate, brief downtime is fine. New Amplify apps are created from the template; the old apps and the old EMPTY backend are retired at the end.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan (or on his explicit yes).
- Never build in /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (its build rewrites content): use a fresh clone or a worktree.
- Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo: feature branch + PR, never push to its main. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus only run kbs.
- Keep article text verbatim (the importer already does; narration hashes depend on it). The Auritus embed is origin-locked to the site key's origin; the production origin stays pilobol.us, so nothing changes there (narration will not play on temporary amplifyapp.com URLs: expected).
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
